verdict.rationale: Pulumi lets users choose where state data lives. Instead of the managed Pulumi Cloud backend, you can use a DIY backend that stores state in an object store you manage (AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage), so you control its location. Self-hosting is also offered. Missing for 10: explicit region or data-residency selection for the managed Pulumi Cloud backend, documentation that frames these options as residency controls, and independent hands-on corroboration.
